parameters.content:
## Path 1: Intake & Contract (PDF)
POST /webhook/enterprise-ops/client-intake
Airtable (Pending Payment) -> Stripe Checkout -> Save session ID -> Supervisor(contract) -> HTML -> index.html -> Gotenberg PDF -> Google Drive -> Merge (restore PDF) -> Gmail (PDF + Stripe link) -> HTTP response
Gotenberg URL: edit it in 'Gotenberg: HTML to PDF'. PDF/HTML failures alert #management-updates and answer 502 with the checkout URL.

## Path 2: Payment & Onboarding
Stripe checkout.session.completed -> paid? -> record found? -> already active? (ignore) -> amount/currency/session match? -> Paid / Active -> Supervisor(onboarding) -> Slack channel, invites, welcome
Unconfirmed / unmatched / mismatched payments alert #management-updates and never onboard.

## Path 3: Weekly Executive Summary
Monday 09:00 -> Airtable metrics -> Supervisor(executive_digest) -> #management-updates

## Multi-agent architecture
Supervisor: REPLACE_WITH_SUPERVISOR_WORKFLOW_ID (deterministic router)
Agent A Contract: REPLACE_WITH_AGENT_A_WORKFLOW_ID
Agent B Onboarding: REPLACE_WITH_AGENT_B_WORKFLOW_ID
Agent C Executive Reporting: REPLACE_WITH_AGENT_C_WORKFLOW_ID
Old records without a saved Stripe Session ID will fail payment validation by design.
